title: Doc comment states the guard must 'precede' the sed anchor ('no test -n "$VAR" …
description:
Doc comment states the guard must 'precede' the sed anchor ('no test -n "$VAR" / [ -n "$VAR" ] guard for that exact variable name precedes it anywhere in the command'), but hasUnguardedSedLineAnchor applies guardRe to the whole command string with no positional constraint, so a guard appearing AFTER the anchor also suppresses the finding. The behavior is the more permissive of the two and is defensible; the comment should be reworded to match it (per the project lesson that a comment does not prove runtime behavior).
